title: Undercut milling operations: T-slot, keyseat, dovetail and lollipop passes that never retract under material

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:max

labels.name: P4
labels.description: Work the maintainer asked for, for the next cut

body:
Asked for by the maintainer (2026-11-13, in chat), after a feature comparison with the open-source project stevecad/camlib: "We wanna cover some of the toolpaths and things like that at first." and, on the suggested picks: "Lets create issues on your suggestions, they made sense." On sources: "We should use perplexity to find literature on those types of toolpaths and not copy them straight up".

What is missing: there are no operations for undercut cutters: T-slot, keyseat/woodruff, dovetail, lollipop. The cutter kinds themselves are open issue 896; this issue is the toolpath and its checks, and needs those kinds for its tools.

Wanted: a 2D "Slot undercut" family. The cutter enters outside the wall (or down a pre-cut slot wide enough for the neck), moves sideways into the undercut at depth, follows the slot or wall, and leaves the same way before any Z retract. Radial stepovers for cutters that cannot take the full width. For dovetail and lollipop the contact point is computed from the tool profile, not the tip.

Safety (why this is not a plain contour): a Z retract while the cutter head is under material is a crash. The op must refuse, by name, any link, retract or lead that lifts the head while its profile overlaps remaining stock above it. The stock simulation and the holder/shank checks must see the real profile (head wider than the neck), so the neck against the slot mouth is judged too.

Sources: step one of the work is a literature search (Perplexity) for published material on undercut and T-slot milling paths and on simulating non-convex tool profiles (tri-dexel or equivalent); the code is written from those and named in the provenance comment. camlib is a feature list only: no code is copied or adapted from it.

Done means: T-slot, keyseat and dovetail passes generate along a straight and a curved slot; a retract inside the undercut is refused in a test; simulation removes the undercut volume with the true profile; golden CL files; MCP tool; an entry slot too narrow for the neck is refused by name; the literature used is cited in the PR.
